_note: Rules synthesised from live get_strategy_column_contract responses (see compiler_probes.json). These govern composition ABOVE the per-metric transform whitelist and are not visible from get_metric_construction_hints alone.

sectionTimeframe.rule: A timeframe-inert (timeframeMode == 'timeless') metric may NOT appear in a custom section that sets an explicit `timeframe` override. It accepts only the section anchor.
sectionTimeframe.consequence: Mixing candle and timeless metrics in one custom section forces that section to omit its timeframe override. To pin a section to an explicit timeframe, every column in it must be candle-backed.

timeframeResolution.note: For timeless metrics `resolved` is always null regardless of the requested rel.

headerNaming.base: the metric's `code` field, not its METRIC key (e.g. VWAP->VWAP, BUY_PRESSURE->buyPres, CLOSE_CHANGE->closeChg, STRUCT_ZONES->zones)
headerNaming.warning: Header names are NOT derivable from the metric key alone. Always confirm via get_strategy_column_contract before writing a strategy condition that references a header.

trackedUniverse.appliesTo: market metrics (price, momentum, trend, volatility, volumeFlow, derivatives, structure)
trackedUniverse.semantics: ordinal across the platform's tracked universe, rendered rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one

reportScoped.semantics: ordinal across THIS REPORT's coins, rendered rank/report-size; computed per request, so it reflects the coins in this report and not the wider market

rankUniverses.warning: Two different denominators behind one transform. A crowd rank of 3 means something different from a VWAP-distance rank of 3.

rankingDoctrine.principle: Raw price-unit metrics never rank. An ordinal over a price level sorts by token denomination - BTC beats DOGE every bar whatever the metric measures.
rankingDoctrine.remedy: Rank the COMPOSITION, not the level: `VWAP x distance x rank` earns the `dist_VWAP` ordinal without VWAP itself ranking.
rankingDoctrine.fallback: Where no composition can produce the quantity, a catalogued percent twin is the remedy, but only with a named consumer (the `atrPct` precedent).
rankingDoctrine.sameLogicApplies: raw base-unit VOLUME also has no rank; use RVOL (a ratio) instead.

rankSuccessor.availableOn: distance (all price-level metrics) and spread (only where rankableSpreadOperands names the operand)
rankSuccessor.orderingWhitelist: chainedRankOrderings, which is separate from the metric's top-level rankOrderings

chaining.formulaComposition: The compiled `formula` is the two stages concatenated with '; '.
chaining.knownDocDefect: For a chained spread->trajectory the compiler's formula text reads 'slots = last N non-null EMA5 values' when the slots actually hold the SPREAD series, not the base metric. Cosmetic in the glossary only; the computed values are correct.

fanOut.rule: Only `trajectory` fans out. Every other transform emits exactly one output header.
fanOut.trajectoryOutputs: window + 1 (window value slots plus one _trend direction output)
fanOut.typePropagation: Slot outputs inherit the BASE metric's nativeOutput kind (numeric stays numeric; classification stays classification with full vocab). The _trend output is always kind 'direction' with vocabulary [rising, falling, flat].
fanOut.budgetImpact: A section of 32 trajectory columns at window 8 emits 32 x 9 = 288 headers. The 32-column limit is not the binding constraint - the ~16000 estimatedTokens budget is.
